# Summary
Comparison post covering cost, lifespan, energy use, space and hard-water maintenance for tankless vs tank water heaters in Arizona. Published 2026-06-22 at `/blog/tankless-vs-tank-water-heater/` (ID 5824).

# Key facts
- Focus keyphrase: tankless vs tank water heater. SEO title (53 chars): "Tankless vs Tank Water Heater: Arizona Guide".
- Links: `/water-heaters/` pillar, tankless installation Chandler and Phoenix, water heater services Chandler, sibling new-water-heater post, contact. Reciprocal link to `/blog/water-pressure-too-high-prv/` held until live (target 21 Aug).
- External sources: two DOE Energy Saver pages (tankless and storage), fetched and confirmed when drafted.
- Later the tankless descaling draft (2026-09-17) noted the live slug is `/blog/tankless-vs-tank-water-heater/`, not the longer "an-arizona-homeowners-guide" slug a brief used.
